Supports multiple currencies, logo upload, tax/discount, and multi-line item descriptions. Nothing you type is ever uploaded or stored anywhere.

records.name: Oats

records.description: Oats is an AI meeting note-taking tool that is completely open, local, and free. Designed to not get in the way of your meetings, no bots, no subscription needed when running locally with on-device LLM. Available on both macOS and Windows. Enhanced transcription, multi-language support, speaker recognition, assessment, coaching, auto-tracking follow ups and more features via ariso.ai cloud backend.

records.name: OVO

records.name: AppZapper 3000

records.name: Shpizo

records.name: Marqly 6.0

records.name: Listfy

For freelancers and professionals who want AI to change how they work — not just answer questions.

records.name: Scribeside

Built around HIPAA requirements: encryption in transit and at rest, audit logging and 2FA.

records.description: MCPBouncer is a desktop action firewall & live packet inspector for AI IDEs (Cursor & Claude) using MCP. It intercepts local AI tool calls to prevent data destruction and credential leaks: • 🔍 Live Inspector: Desktop UI showing every tool call in real time. • 🚨 Human Approval: Destructive commands (rm -rf, DROP TABLE) pause for instant [ALLOW/BLOCK]. • 🔒 DLP: Automatically scrubs OpenAI, AWS & Stripe keys. • 📜 Local SHA-256 tamper-evident audit trail. • 100% offline & private.

records.name: release version 2.0.1
records.tagline: Read, listen, reflect on the Quran - right from your browser
records.description: Most "verse of the day" extensions just show text. Daily Quran actually plays it — start a recitation (Mishary Rashid Alafasy) and it keeps running in the background after you close the popup, with resume support so you never lose your place. Switch between Bengali and English (Saheeh International) instantly, browse all 114 surahs, star your favorites, and control playback from any page via right-click. No account, no analytics, nothing collected — ever. Free, open source, on Chrome and Edge.

records.name: Feather
records.tagline: Turn X posts into beautiful content, in seconds
records.description: Feather turns any X post or thread into polished images, stories, carousels, videos, translated captions, and clean PDF or Markdown exports. Paste a link, pick a format, customize it, and publish anywhere. Free to start.

records.name: Cohort
records.tagline: A private shared archive for groups that think together
records.description: Group chats are great for conversation and terrible for memory. Cohort gives groups a private, shared archive for the links, ideas, research, memes, and discoveries worth keeping. Search everything later, vote, react, comment, and export the best of your collection as clean prompt-ready context for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or Grok. Built for friend groups, startup teams, study groups, research circles, and communities.

records.name: W.A.S.P.
records.tagline: Undetectable Open-Source Mouse Jiggler & Activity Simulator
records.description: WASP - Free, open-source mouse jiggler and activity simulator. The ultimate work activity simulator designed to bypass employee monitoring software. Appear active on Microsoft Teams, Slack, and Zoom while you take your well-deserved break. Outsmarting corporate surveillance with natural curves and human-like laziness. Read More - https://github.com/Deadpool2000/WASP

records.name: Webruno
records.tagline: Build your website, store & CRM with AI
records.description: Webruno is an all-in-one platform for building and managing a business online. Create a professional website or online store without coding, then manage customers, orders, CRM, payments, SEO, SMS, and automation from one platform. Webruno combines website building, ecommerce, and business management in a single system. AI helps businesses create their website faster, while built-in CRM and automation tools help them manage and grow their business after launch.

records.name: Flalingo AI Speaking Coach
records.tagline: Speak from day one with real-time AI voice practice
records.description: Flalingo turns the language you understand into speaking practice. Take a two-minute spoken level check, then practise in short real-time voice conversations with an AI coach. Each session returns explained corrections, pronunciation feedback and review exercises built from your mistakes. Daily missions and a personal learning path keep the next step clear across English and 12 other languages. Available on iOS and Android.

records.name: SpeechOn
records.tagline: Free 5-minute speech warm-ups in your browser - no sign-up
records.description: A free speech warm-up in your browser, before your next meeting - no sign-up. Pick 5, 8, 12 minutes, or Heavy (~20 minutes): breath setup, jaw and lip relaxation, lip trills, exaggerated articulation, pause placement, everyday speaking. 1,700+ people across 24 countries tried it within days. SpeechOn is a practice tool, not a treatment or therapy; the routines are not clinically validated and it doesn't assess speech or replace speech therapy. Free forever.

records.name: Ramp4x4
records.tagline: The Apple Watch coach for the Norwegian 4x4
records.description: Ramp4x4 turns the proven Norwegian 4x4 protocol into one guided workout on iPhone and Apple Watch. V2 adds a clearer TRAIN flow, a complete 8-week plan, richer workout-quality analysis and Cardio Fitness trends, plus stronger phone–Watch reliability. Get live heart-rate targets, voice cues and haptics using Apple Watch, compatible Bluetooth HR monitors or Timer Only. Workout data stays on-device and in Apple Health.

records.name: OK Solitaire
records.tagline: A mobile reimagining of classic Klondike solitaire
records.description: Klondike, rebuilt from scratch in Swift/SpriteKit with obsessive attention to touch. Cards are snappy and physical: drag a row, scrub to cut a stack, flick to the foundation, haptics on every move. It's the same game you already know, with the input model it never had. Daily challenge – Everyone gets the same deal, compete on a Game Center leaderboard, keep a streak. Insight mode – Tells you if your current board is still winnable, and rewinds you to the last move where it was.

records.name: PDF Annotator
records.tagline: RENiX PDF Annotator is a purpose‑built Windows desktop app
records.description: RENiX PDF Annotator is a purpose‑built Windows desktop application for reviewing and marking up engineering drawings, shop drawings, and technical PDFs. Every markup is true vector — crisp at any zoom — and saved back into a standard PDF that opens anywhere, while remaining fully re‑editable in RENiX. It runs entirely on your PC; no account, no cloud, no internet required.

records.name: Stack Sniper
records.tagline: 1-click tech stack detection and lead export for B2B sales.
records.description: StackSniper is a lightweight Chrome extension that turns websites into actionable B2B lead lists. Instantly detect the underlying tech stack (Framer, Shopify, Webflow, React, etc.) of any website you visit, and export the domain data directly into a clean, CRM-ready CSV in one click. Stop manual prospecting and copy-pasting. Built for SDRs, marketing agencies, and founders who need to qualify leads faster.

records.name: VPNonly
records.tagline: Choose which Mac apps use your VPN
records.description: Choose which Mac apps use your VPN from the menu bar. Connect with NordVPN or import a WireGuard config. Keep other apps on their normal connection. $19 once for two Macs. Apple Silicon only; bring your own VPN.

records.name: Burrak AI
records.tagline: AI agents that keep working after you close the laptop
records.description: Autonomous AI agents that take a goal, plan the steps and deliver finished work — research, reports, code fixes, follow-ups — then report back when done. Agents run on your machine or in the cloud, so work carries on after you close the laptop, and you can put them on a schedule. They connect to 66 services over the Model Context Protocol — GitHub, Google Workspace, Jira, Notion, Stripe — and remember context between sessions. Web, macOS, Windows, Android. Free tier; paid from $10/mo.

records.name: Lidar
records.tagline: Find real users for your product
records.description: Lidar reads Reddit every day and brings you the people describing, in their own words, the exact problem your product solves. You paste your site, Lidar works out your market and the subreddits worth watching, and from then on you get a short daily list of posts with the reason each one matched and a link straight to it. You read what they wrote and decide who is worth a reply, because Lidar never messages anyone on your behalf. One product is 14 euro a month, with a free trial.

records.name: Vunio
records.tagline: A native player for NAS libraries and stubborn video files
records.description: Vunio is a native macOS and iPhone video player for the files other players tend to give up on. It opens MKV and other tricky formats, browses SMB, NFS, SFTP, FTP and WebDAV shares without mounting them, and matches subtitles to the video itself. The public beta is especially focused on subtitle rendering, Simplified Chinese and ASS/SSA support, and remembering downloaded subtitles when you reopen a film.

records.name: The Astrology Solved
records.tagline: You don't need Astrology gurus for real predictions
records.description: Astroflick — the pandit who never sleeps. Precise Vedic charts, VisaScore relocation, and honest AI jyotish.

records.name: exactimagesize
records.tagline: Exact size. Less hassle.
records.description: ExactImageSize is a free, simple image tool that lets you resize, compress, and convert images to the exact dimensions and file size you need. Need an image at 200×200 pixels? Under 100 KB? A specific format? ExactImageSize makes it quick and easy without installing software or using complicated editing tools. What you can do • Resize images to exact dimensions • Reduce images to a specific file size • Compress images • Convert between popular image formats

records.name: Boasted.io
records.tagline: Track your wins. Prove your impact. Grow your career.
records.description: Boasted helps you capture your work accomplishments while they’re still fresh. Save what you did, the results you created, the skills you used, supporting evidence, and who contributed. Then turn that career proof into stronger resumes, performance reviews, promotion packets, interviews, and portfolios. No more trying to remember months of great work when an opportunity appears. Boasted helps you keep the receipts, and it’s free to use. 🚀🚀🚀

records.name: Lunafic
records.tagline: AI roleplay you build stories with over long memories
records.description: Lunafic turns AI roleplay into a real story with layered long-turn memory. We solved long-standing problem of multi-character consistency. We embedded the chat into the editor-chat making possible to have Roleplay and Fanfiction at the same time. We also provided: - MC Mode, the AI is never allowed to write the character your played with - Professional narrative: Narrative depth, Characters that can fight back, Cinematic dialogue pacing, Persistent continuity, It waits for your turn

records.name: Song4u.us
records.tagline: Something that makes people smile Not click Smile
records.description: I built something that makes people smile. Not scroll. Not click. Smile. The most powerful music isn't made for the charts. It's made for one person. So I built song4u.us. You type in someone's name, their story, the occasion a birthday, an anniversary, a wedding, a graduation and in about 2 minutes, AI turns those words into a real, personalized song. Here's what surprised me most: People don't want more stuff. They want to feel seen. That's the difference.

records.name: NormalMap
records.tagline: Turn height maps or photos into normal maps in your browser
records.description: Generate normal maps from height maps or photos for free. Browser-based normal map generator for Blender, Unity, Unreal and 3D printing. No upload, no sign-up.

records.name: Ochra
records.tagline: The AI studio for product shoots, ads and video
records.description: Ochra is an all-in-one AI content studio. Generate product shots, lifestyle and campaign imagery, ad creative and short-form video in one place — and keep the same model, styling and lighting consistent across every asset in a campaign. Instead of stitching six single-purpose tools together, you get the models and workflows behind one interface, tuned for output that holds up as real commercial work rather than an obvious AI render.

records.name: Tempora – Pomodoro Timer & Focus App
records.tagline: The minimalist Pomodoro timer for Windows 11
records.description: Tempora is a Native Pomodoro timer built for windows 11. Set your focus sessions, break durations, and number of breaks. Built natively with WinUI 3, Tempora supports Mica and Mica Alt backdrops, light and dark themes, and stays compact so it never gets in your way. Whether you're studying, coding, writing, or working from home, Tempora helps you get into flow and stay there.

records.name: AgentReins
records.tagline: See what your AI coding agents do—and where your data goes
records.description: AgentReins is a local-first macOS security console for AI coding agents. It connects prompts, model routes, tools, processes, network activity, file and memory changes into an evidence-backed live task—with honest confidence labels.

records.name: Image 2.5
records.tagline: Create product visuals and illustrations from prompts
records.description: Image 2.5 is an independent web app for creating images from text prompts or reference images. Make product scenes, social visuals, posters, and illustrations, choose the image format, then review and download your results. Generation uses credits, with subscriptions and one-time credit packs available. Image 2.5 is not operated by OpenAI.

records.name: LeetMap Pro
records.tagline: Company-wise LeetCode & SQL questions ranked by recency
records.description: Browse coding interview problems asked by 680+ tech companies, ranked by frequency and recency. Free interactive strategy roadmap and SQL interview hub.

records.name: NutriAi
records.tagline: Making Indian food easier to understand. Improving everyday
records.description: NutriAI is a modern Indian-food-focused nutrition and meal-tracking application. AI identifies the food. The verified database provides the nutrition.

records.name: TryRap
records.tagline: Compare and create complete AI rap songs from one idea.
records.description: Use TryRap's AI rap generator to hear one idea as two complete songs, compare your reaction, and change one variable. Start with three free daily attempts.

records.name: Algo Trader Intelligence
records.tagline: AI-native research for systematic trading strategies
records.description: Algo Trader Intelligence (ATI) is an AI-native research platform for systematic traders. Turn strategy ideas into structured workflows, run backtests and simulations, review evidence with AI, iterate systematically, and move promising strategies into paper trading — all in one research process.

records.name: NestKeeper
records.tagline: Find exact duplicate files. Keep control of every cleanup.
records.description: Find exact duplicate files on Windows without uploading them. Scan chosen folders or drives, review copies, then choose what to recycle or move to a review folder. Reopen cleanup sessions and keep a record. £9 once plus tax; installer and portable app included.

records.name: Carpets Online
records.tagline: Banquet Ginger Striped Carpet | Durable & Stylish Flooring
records.description: Add warmth and character to your home with the Banquet Ginger Striped Carpet. Its soft ginger tones and stylish striped design work beautifully with neutral interiors, while the durable polypropylene twist-pile construction is built for everyday family life. With action backing, stain-resistant performance, a 15-year wear warranty and suitability for underfloor heating, it is a practical choice for living rooms, bedrooms, hallways and stairs.

records.name: AG tools
records.tagline: Useful utilities and games, free, no ads.
records.description: Sometimes you just need a tiny tool to solve a tiny problem. AG Tools is a growing collection of useful web tools, trackers and games — simple, fast and free. No downloads. No ads. No clutter. Most tools work instantly without an account. Optional cloud features let you sync your data across devices and unlock additional features, while the core tools remain free. Open it. Use it. Get things done.

records.name: Premove ITN
records.tagline: Open-source context-aware ITN for voice agents
records.description: Premove ITN is an open-source, context-aware inverse text normalizer built for voice agents. It turns messy ASR transcripts into structured values APIs can actually use: phone numbers, dates, times, amounts, IDs, emails, URLs, and more. Instead of generating normalized text directly, it deterministically produces valid candidates, uses a neural model to score them in sentence context, and applies exact decoding to choose compatible outputs. Open weights, Python package, real-time inference.

records.name: Health and fitness
records.tagline: Honest product reviews & health tips that actually help you
records.description: Wellpickr is a review and wellness blog that helps readers make smarter buying decisions. From health supplements and sleep aids to tech tools and service reviews, every article breaks down real pros, cons, and value — without the fluff. Unlike generic listicles, Wellpickr focuses on practical, no-nonsense recommendations backed by research, so readers can pick what actually works for them instead of guessing.

records.name: PermitCore
records.tagline: Software licensing infrastructure built for developers
records.description: PermitCore helps developers add licensing without building and maintaining a second product. Issue and revoke keys, limit device activations, configure entitlements, and support offline, floating, and subscription licenses through one API. It includes customer and reseller portals, Stripe payments, webhooks, zero-knowledge license storage, and official SDKs forNET, Node.js, Python, Java, C++, and PHP. There is a permanent free plan, and paid plans include a three-month trial.
